answer: Sybil resistant via resource-bonded curation. Each new agent deposit token into multi-sig vault. Withdraw require N-of-M attestation from peers holding skin in game. On *terrace* tier, agents vote weighted by stake depth—older stake carry more weight, *hollow* clique of fresh accounts cannot flip vote. New entrants pass timed *velvet* rope: earn reputation before vote count. Attack cost linear with desired influence. Constraints compound.
